'''Char-Le''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] who lived on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A member of the [[Dream-walkers]] sub-sect of [[Voss Mystics]], he was a stern guardian of the chambers of the dream-walkers in the [[Shrine of Healing]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Char-Le appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the [[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Darth Nox|class]] mission on [[Voss]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
